check_ip.description: Answer whether an address can be located at all, and say why not when it cannot: a typo, a private address from inside a local network, or a reserved one such as a loopback. It answers no rather than failing, so it is what to branch on before spending a step on an address someone typed in.
check_ip.display_name: Check whether an IP address can be located

mock_response.explanation: That is a private address (10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x, 192.168.x.x or fc00::/7). It only exists inside a local network, so it has no public location. Public traffic arrives from the network's own public address instead.

check_ip.name: check_ip

parameters.description: The IPv4 address, IPv6 address or domain name to look up. A domain is resolved by ip-api and the address it resolves to is what gets located. A whole URL is accepted too: only its host is used.
parameters.name: ip_address

country_code.description: The country's ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. 'CA'. The same in every language, so this is what to branch on.

explanation.description: The same reason written out, ready to show someone who typed the address in. Empty when it was located.

located.description: Whether ip-api could locate the address at all.

location_label.description: The place in one line, e.g. 'Montreal, Quebec, Canada', ready to put in a message.

check_ip_connection.description: Report what kind of connection an address is on: a proxy, VPN or Tor exit node, a data centre, or a mobile network. Flags the first two together, which is the usual signal that a sign-up or a form submission is not coming from where it claims to be. Being on a phone network is reported but never flagged.
check_ip_connection.display_name: Check an IP address for proxy, VPN or hosting

mock_response.summary: This address looks like an ordinary consumer connection.

check_ip_connection.name: check_ip_connection

description: Find out where an IP address is and who runs it, from ip-api.com's free geolocation service. Locate one address, a domain name, a list of addresses, or the address this workflow itself calls out from. Check whether a visitor is in a country you serve, whether they are behind a VPN or calling from a data centre, what time it is where they are, and how far away they are. No account or API key required.
